title: 独立三维验收报告 — corrected L1–L5 physical layer model (R9)
formal_acceptance_reason: L2-L5 physical heights are exploratory unconfirmed_simulation parameters (SCHEMA_L3D.md §1); formal process acceptance is refused for every payload. Only exploratory geometry verdicts are reported.

ten_checks.requirement: L1 is the interface layer and contains BOTH port rows (z1=0.0 mm, z2=0.5 mm)
Two same-column ports of the two rows keep their 0.5 mm real 3D distance
Every route starts/ends exactly on a correct L1 port with the correct row z
Transitions L1->L2..L5 are legal (R=15, theta/footprint/length from dz, endpoints and horizontal tangent continuity)
Intermediate-layer / multiple / multi-layer transitions are legal and every layer pair is allowed by the symmetric allowed_transitions graph
Full 3D curvature: path sampled at <=0.02 mm, min circumradius >= 14.985 mm; flat arcs exactly R=15, lines axis-aligned, transitions analytic R=15
Transitions / other-layer parts vs L1 row flats: true 3D distance >= 0.08 mm (no crossing exemption across different physical z)
Same logical layer but different physical height is checked in real 3D; same physical z planar pairs use the frozen strict 2D rules (legal crossings only)
layer_id is never used as a z coordinate (same layer_id with different z -> distinct planes; different layer_ids at close z -> still checked/rejected)
Unconfirmed / invalid L2-L5 heights refuse formal acceptance (status=exploratory_only, formal_acceptance=false)

notes: Every item was validated by rebuilding all geometry from the JSON parameters (transitions from dz/radius, flats from 2D primitives); no router flag or saved validation field was trusted.

The two baselines contain fixed L1 flats only (0 transitions); the six scheme/stack finals include real multi-transition/multi-layer routes after the stage-4 local re-layering (routed count unchanged).

Same physical-z flat pairs use the frozen strict 2D pair audit (legal crossing windows allowed); every transition-involved pair and every different-physical-z pair is checked in true 3D with no exemption.
Exit code with --allow-exploratory is 0 for every item; without the flag the validator returns 3 (formal refusal) for all items.
